8: ## 1. 目标与固定结论
9: 
10: 目标是在 BK7258 上运行一个 NuttX SMP 实例：物理 CPU1 和 CPU2 共同执行同一个
11: OpenVela `nuttx.bin`，目标 AP 核频率为 480 MHz。物理 CPU0 继续运行 Armino CP，
12: 并继续拥有全芯片电源、DPLL、核心/总线时钟、电压、PSRAM PHY、硬件 WDT 和
13: CPU1 电源生命周期。
14: 
15: 正式架构固定为：
16: 
17: | 物理核 | NuttX 编号 | 角色 | 目标频率 |
18: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
19: | CPU0 | 不可见 | Armino CP，电源/频率执行者 | 240 MHz（480 MHz档位下） |
20: | CPU1 | 0 | OpenVela AP primary、系统 tick、CP transport owner | 480 MHz |
21: | CPU2 | 1 | OpenVela AP secondary、通用 SMP 调度 | 480 MHz |
22: 
23: BK7258 的 `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 不是三核都运行 480 MHz。原厂档位意图是：
24: 
25: ```text
26: core source: 480 MHz
27: CPU0:       240 MHz
28: CPU1:       480 MHz
29: CPU2:       480 MHz
30: bus:        240 MHz
31: ```

34: `sys_hal_core_bus_clock_ctrl()` 虽接收 `ckdiv_bus`，实际只改 `CLK_DIV_REG0[3:0]`
35: 的 core divider，没有写 bit 6 的 bus divider。因此 CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 目标值有源码
36: 依据，bus 240 MHz 仍是必须通过寄存器和实测确认的目标，不能只凭档位注释验收。

38: 依据为：

40: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/pm.h:346-353`
41: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:571-658`

44: 必须同时接受以下结论：
45: 
46: 1. 不能只打开 `CONFIG_SMP`。CPU2 reset/vector、核 ID、每核中断栈、IPI、
47:    SMP atomic 和驱动并发都必须实现。
48: 2. 不能只把 AP `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 改为 480 MHz。CP 是共享核心时钟的
49:    唯一执行者，必须在释放 CPU1 reset 前建立 480 MHz vote，并在 AP 停止后释放。
50: 3. 首版 480 MHz SMP 运行期间禁止 runtime DVFS。CPU1/CPU2 的核心时钟变化会直接
51:    改变 SysTick；没有 pre-change/post-change 协议和时间补偿时，运行中改频会破坏
52:    timeout、sleep、scheduler tick 和 heartbeat。
53: 4. `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y` 是必需配置，不是可选优化。当前 32 位配置已经造成
54:    可重复的长期静置重启。
55: 5. CPU2 不需要独立镜像或分区。CPU1/CPU2 共享 `app1.bin`、地址空间和调度器；
56:    CPU2 只需要同一镜像内的 secondary boot vector。
57: 6. CPU2 启动失败时不得静默降级为单核。`CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2` 下必须 fail-stop，
58:    否则 NuttX per-CPU 和调度器状态不完整。
59: 7. 首版只支持普通 idle WFI。CP coordinated low-voltage、CPU1/CPU2 掉电、CPU2
60:    hotplug 和 runtime DVFS 必须在独立阶段完成，不得和首次 SMP bring-up 混合。

103: ## 3. 已确认的长期重启与频率缺陷
104: 
105: ### 3.1 32 位时间乘法溢出导致 heartbeat 永久阻塞
106: 
107: AP heartbeat worker 位于：
108: 
109: ```c
110: for (;;)
111:   {
112:     nxsig_usleep(2000000);
113:     bk7258_mbox_send_message(... IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ...);
114:   }
115: ```
116: 
117: 来源：
118: 
119: - `contest/.../chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:70-82`
120: 
121: 当前最终配置同时满足：
122: 
123: ```text
124: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
125: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
126: # CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64 is not set
127: ```
128: 
129: NuttX generic architecture timer 使用：
130: 
131: ```c
132: static uint64_t current_usec(void)
133: {
134:   ...
135:   return TICK2USEC(timebase) + (status.timeout - status.timeleft);
136: }
137: ```
138: 
139: `timebase` 是 32 位 `clock_t`，`TICK2USEC` 为：
140: 
141: ```c
142: #define TICK2USEC(tick) ((tick) * USEC_PER_TICK)
143: ```
144: 
145: `1000L` 在 32 位 ARM 上仍为 32 位，因此乘法在转换为 `uint64_t` 之前已经溢出。
146: 编译产物也显示只有低 32 位 `mla`，返回值高 32 位被置零。AP 时间会在：
147: 
148: ```text
149: 2^32 us = 4,294,967.296 ms AP time
150: ```
151: 
152: 提前跳回零，而不是在正常的 32 位 tick 边界回卷。跨界前创建的两秒 sleep deadline
153: 大于这个人为最大值，回卷后的时钟永远到不了 deadline，heartbeat 线程永久阻塞。
154: 
155: CP 的 heartbeat fallback timeout 为 6000 ms。实板多次日志均满足：
156: 
157: ```text
158: current - last_heartbeat = 6000 ms
159: Assert at: mb_ipc_task:298
160: ```
161: 
162: 所以重启是 CP 在 AP heartbeat 停止后执行的确定性断言，不是随机复位。
163: 
164: 必需修复：
165: 
166: ```text
167: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
168: ```
169: 
170: 不能只把 heartbeat 改成 busy wait、分段 sleep 或增大 CP timeout。这些只能隐藏一个
171: 调用者，Mailbox worker、semaphore timeout 和其他 watchdog deadline 仍会失效。
172: 
173: ### 3.2 CP 60 MHz 与 AP 120 MHz 配置不一致
174: 
175: 当前 AP SysTick 使用：
176: 
177: ```c
178: systick_initialize(true, CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ, -1);
179: ```
180: 
181: AP 配置是 120 MHz，但 CP 配置和初始化代码会执行：
182: 
183: ```text
184: CONFIG_CPU_DEFAULT_FREQ_60M=y
185: bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT, PM_CPU_FRQ_60M)
186: ```
187: 
188: 而 60 MHz 档位同时影响 CPU0、CPU1、CPU2 和 bus。结果是 AP 以 120 MHz 计算的
189: 1 ms SysTick 实际约为 2 ms，2 秒 heartbeat 实际约为 4 秒。
190: 
191: 这也精确解释了重启为何发生在约 2 小时 23 分，而不是约 1 小时 11 分：
192: 
193: ```text
194: 4,294.967296 s * (120 / 60) = 8,589.934592 s
195: ```
196: 
197: 实板在约 `8,594.5 s` assert，差值位于最后一帧 heartbeat 到 6 秒 timeout 的窗口。
198: 
199: ### 3.3 CP heartbeat 配置符号错误
200: 
201: CP heartbeat 代码检查 `CONFIG_WDT_EN`，当前生成配置实际使用 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 和
202: `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS=8000`。所以最终固件走的是 `2000 * 3 = 6000 ms` fallback。
203: 
204: 应将 CP 条件改为实际 watchdog 配置符号，并明确 heartbeat timeout 策略。但即使改成
205: 8 秒，也不能替代 AP 时间和频率修复。
206: 
207: ## 4. 电源、频率与核生命周期所有权
208: 
209: ### 4.1 所有权表
210: 
211: | 资源 | 唯一执行者 | OpenVela AP 职责 |
212: | --- | --- | --- |
213: | DPLL/core source/core divider/bus divider | CPU0/CP PM | 只声明固定 480 MHz 契约并校验结果；bus divider 未验证前不得发布 ready |
214: | VDDD/VDDDIG 高压档 | CPU0/CP PM | 不直接写 analog/PMU 电压寄存器 |
215: | CPU1 power/reset/boot offset | CPU0/CP | 发送 ready/recovery，不能直接关闭自身 |
216: | CPU2 power domain | CPU0/CP | 请求域保持 ON；不得直接改 `CPU2_PWR_DW/HALT` 绕过 CP accounting |
217: | CPU2 reset/boot offset | CPU1/AP primary | `up_cpu_start(1)` 写 secondary vector 并释放 reset |
218: | CPU2 scheduler/idle/IPI | OpenVela SMP | 完整管理 |
219: | PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟、容量检测 | CPU0/CP | 通过 PWC vote；只管理 AP allocator |
220: | SysTick 和 NuttX monotonic time | CPU1/OpenVela | 固定频率下维护；低压阶段用 AON 时间补偿 |
221: | WDT 和 heartbeat assert | CPU0/CP | AP 持续发送 heartbeat，处理 transport 错误 |
222: 
223: 这里的 ID 属于两个不同命名空间：`PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 是共享 frequency vote 表的 owner
224: slot，不是 CPU1 power-domain ID，也不存在 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU2` frequency slot。CPU1/CPU2
225: 电源必须分别使用 `PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`、`PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2`。当前 power
226: enum 中 CPU1、APP、CPU2 的值依次为17、18、19；禁止根据公共头文件中的过时数字注释
227: 硬编码 ID。

229: ### 4.2 480 MHz 启动时序
230: 
231: CP 必须在释放 CPU1 reset 之前建立 480 MHz，不能等 AP 启动后再通过 PWC 改频：
232: 
233: ```text
234: CP OpenVela AP boot transaction
235:   -> sole owner写PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 = PM_CPU_FRQ_480M
236:   -> 验证owner slot、PM cache和实际clock/voltage寄存器
237:   -> 用语义化helper确认CPU2处于reset-hold
238:   -> 获取OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold并确认domain ON
239:   -> power CPU1 domain ON
240:   -> 按34-byte CRC physical到32-byte logical规则计算CPU1 boot offset
241:   -> 用已验证的语义化helper release CPU1 reset
242:   -> CPU1 OpenVela 按 480 MHz 初始化 SysTick
243:   -> nx_start()内部调用nx_smp_start()/up_cpu_start(1)
244:   -> CPU1 设置 CPU2 secondary vector并用语义化helper release reset
245:   -> CPU2 online和双向IPI自检
246:   -> 发送IPC power-up并启动heartbeat
247:   -> 发送PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD解除CP启动等待
248:   -> 请求并验证PSRAM PWC
249:   -> 成功后发布独立的最终AP/PSRAM-ready门禁
250: ```
251: 
252: `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` 必须先于PSRAM请求：当前CP从low-power worker启动CPU1并在同一
253: worker中等待boot-ready，PSRAM vote也由该worker处理；反向排序会造成双方互等。这里的
254: 最终ready是给上层allocator/driver的独立门禁，不能替换或延后现有boot-ready。
255: 
256: CP 侧建议增加显式配置 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M`，只在外部 OpenVela AP 构建中启用，
257: 避免改变原厂 FreeRTOS AP 的默认行为。该配置下修改：
258: 
259: - `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 只有一个覆盖式 byte slot，不是引用计数。480 MHz vote 必须只有
260:   一个生命周期 owner；建议由新的 OpenVela boot transaction 在任何 CPU1/CPU2 power-on
261:   前写入。`user_app_main()` 只请求事务启动，`pm_module_bootup_cpu1()` 不得重复投同一 slot。
262: - `PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT=60M` 可保留。PM 取所有 slot 最大值，AP online 时480M胜出；AP
263:   vote释放后回到60M是当前CP配置的正常策略。只有明确要求AP关闭后CP回到120M时，才
264:   条件跳过最终60M写入，该选择不是建立480M契约的必要条件。
265: - `bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get()` 只是软件 cache。上电前必须同时校验
266:   `bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1)`、current max、core source、core
267:   divider、bus divider、CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 speed和VDDDIG；软件状态与寄存器不一致即失败。
268: - 新增 OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold API。它只做独立 owner accounting、控制
269:   `PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2` 并等待power readback；不得调用 `start_cpu2_core()`、写
270:   CPU2 offset或release reset。现有boot-vote API会同时启动CPU2，不适用于单镜像NuttX。
271: - CPU1 boot继续复用 `get_partition_addr(1)` 的34-byte CRC physical到32-byte logical
272:   转换及SoC address处理，最终寄存器写入转换后地址的 `offset >> 8`，不得写raw partition
273:   start。
274: - 裸 `CPU1/2_SW_RST=0/1` 的HAL注释与原厂start/stop helper语义矛盾。实施时必须提供
275:   `cpu_hold_reset()`/`cpu_release_reset()`，通过run-status和实板启动试验确定极性并修正
276:   注释；方案和日志不能把未经验证的裸值直接命名为assert/release。
277: - `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/Kconfig`：增加 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` bool 选项，
278:   默认关闭；只在 `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` 中由 OpenVela 构建启用。
279: 
280: 所有 CP 源码修改必须同时在比赛仓 `external/bk_avdk_smp/` 权威副本中保留，并更新
281: `external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md` 的覆盖文件表和同步命令，不能只修改
282: `bk_avdk_smp` 构建树。同步方法见该 README 第 2 节。

326: 必须透传真实 `bk_psram_init()` 结果，只有成功后才能置owner bit和发布ready。协议定义为
327: request `param3=PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1`；response `param1` 回显ON/OFF state、`param2` 携带
328: 真实 `ret`、`param3` 回显version。不支持的version返回错误且不得修改owner bitmap，
329: AP/CP双方必须同时更新。AP释放自己的owner不能关闭仍被CP owner使用的PHY。
330: 
331: ### 4.3 运行期频率规则
332: 
333: 首版运行期规则只有一条：AP online 时 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 始终 vote 480 MHz。
334: 
335: - CP 默认60 MHz vote可以保留；PM取所有module slot的最大值，AP生命周期内唯一的480M
336:   slot会把共享时钟保持在480 MHz。
337: - AP 不发送 `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` 降频。
338: - 其他 CP/AP module 可以投票，但不能把最大值降到 480 MHz以下。
339: - CP 应提供诊断查询，至少输出 current max vote、全部vote owner、core source、core/bus
340:   divider、CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 speed、VDDD/VDDDIG、CPU1/CPU2 power/reset和PSRAM owner状态。
341: - `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 被 `CONFIG_CLK_FORCE_MAX_CPU_FREQ_320M` 截断时必须判为启动失败，
342:   不能继续用 480 MHz SysTick配置运行。
343: 
344: 保留 `PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD` 命令值 `0xc`，同步扩展AP/CP的
345: `pm_ap_get_cp_data_type_e`，增加只读current-frequency与divider查询类型。扩展必须同时
346: 更新双方header和source override，不能单边复用已有enum数值。
347: 
348: ### 4.4 关闭与故障回滚
349: 
350: 正常关闭或 AP recovery 的顺序必须是：
351: 
352: ```text
353: AP primary停止新任务和外设提交
354:   -> quiesce PSRAM/DMA/Mailbox UART
355:   -> 调度CPU2执行stop callback
356:   -> 屏蔽CPU2普通IRQ和IPI
357:   -> CPU2进入确认的park/WFI状态
358:   -> CPU1用语义化helper将CPU2置reset并确认不再执行
359:   -> AP释放自己的PSRAM PWC owner并等待CP ACK
360:   -> AP向CP回复recovery-ready
361:   -> CP确认CPU2 reset，释放power-only hold并确认CPU2 domain OFF
362:   -> CP停止/reset CPU1并确认CPU1 domain OFF
363:   -> CP以PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT释放PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 slot
364:   -> CP按CPU档位和剩余PSRAM owner重新计算VDDDIG
365: ```
366: 
367: 当前 CP shutdown 代码仅在特定低压配置下才停止 CPU2，而且顺序是先停止 CPU1、后停止
368: CPU2。OpenVela SMP 模式必须改成上述顺序。CPU2仍在执行共享NuttX状态时，CP不能
369: 直接关闭CPU2 power；CPU1已停止后也不能再依赖CPU1去park CPU2。
370: 
371: 所有失败必须达到相同后置条件，但不能强制走同一callback路径：CPU1/CPU2不执行、只对
372: 本事务已获取的CPU2/CPU1 domain、OpenVela PSRAM owner和480M slot按反序释放。
373: 
374: - 480M/readback失败发生在CPU1 release前：CP直接撤销已获取资源，不等待AP。
375: - CPU1 boot超时：CP强制CPU1/CPU2 reset并关闭domain，不等待AP recovery。
376: - CPU2 online超时：CPU1若仍可信就强制CPU2 reset，不能依赖未online的stop callback。
377: - 只有正常recovery才使用完整AP quiesce、park和ready握手。
378: 
379: ## 5. 睡眠与低功耗分阶段方案
380: 
381: ### 5.1 阶段 P0：普通 WFI，禁止 coordinated low-voltage
382: 
383: 首次 SMP 和 480 MHz 验收只启用 per-core 普通 WFI：
384: 
385: - 增加BK7258 `up_idle()`；当前公共ARM `up_idle()`中的WFI被 `#if 0` 禁用，不能把
386:   “空闲任务在运行”误判为已经WFI。chip hook必须清 `SCB_SCR_SLEEPDEEP`，执行
387:   `DSB; WFI; ISB`，且不设置coordinated low-voltage ready bit。
388: - CP在每次OpenVela启动和recovery时显式调用
389:   `bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0)` 并检查 `BK_OK`。
390:   state 0表示AP active/not-ready，因此全芯片low-voltage条件不成立。
391: - 保持 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 关闭。
392: - 不支持 CPU1/CPU2 power-down、retention、CPU2 hotplug 或 tickless。
393: - heartbeat、Mailbox 和 SysTick 在普通 WFI 下仍可唤醒 CPU1。
394: 
395: CP 的 `PM_ENTER_LOW_VOL_MODULES_CONFIG` 包含 `PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`。启动 OpenVela
396: AP 时应显式写exit-sleep，不能依赖BSS初值；PM初始化实际上会把CPU1置为enter-sleep，
397: 而当前清除代码又受已关闭的 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 条件控制。OpenVela必须
398: 独立执行上述调用，保证未实现低压协议时CP只能进入normal sleep。
399: 
400: ### 5.2 阶段 P1：双核 coordinated low-voltage
401: 
402: 只有 P0 的 24 小时稳定性通过后，才能实现原厂 AP 的等价低压协议。原厂事实为：
403: 
404: - CP 要求 CPU1 和 CPU2 都进入 WFI，并检查 AON PMU 的
405:   `cp1_enter_wfi_state`、`cp2_enter_wfi_state`。
406: - AP 两个核分别屏蔽普通 IRQ，只保留本核 Mailbox wakeup。
407: - CP 保存并切换核心/Flash 时钟，恢复 DPLL 后再唤醒 AP。
408: - 原 AP 依赖 FreeRTOS SMP idle 和 `vPortYieldCore()`；这些调用不能直接移植到 NuttX。
409: 
410: NuttX实现必须复用现有SMP PM框架，而不是另建平行barrier：
411: 
412: 1. 启用 `CONFIG_PM=y`、选定governor、`CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3` 和
413:    `CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0`；这里的0是NuttX logical CPU0/物理CPU1，不是CP。
414: 2. BK7258 `up_idle()` 调用 `pm_idle(handler)`；驱动通过 `pm_register()` 注册
415:    `struct pm_callback_s` prepare/notify callback。
416: 3. logical CPU0作为last CPU发起全局transition，禁止新任务迁移、DMA和mailbox
417:    transaction；两核运行per-CPU prepare并保存本核NVIC/SysTick状态。
418: 4. CPU2设置 `cp2_enter_wfi_state` 后进入WFI；CPU1确认CPU2已就绪。
419: 5. CPU1停止SysTick，设置 `cp1_enter_wfi_state`，通过既有sleep vote允许CP进入低压。
420: 6. CP只在两个AON WFI bit、AP sleep/clock vote和mailbox idle都满足后切换低压。
421: 7. CP恢复DPLL、经readback验证的480 MHz档位和bus后，通过Mailbox唤醒AP。
422: 8. CPU1读取AON elapsed time，恢复monotonic time和SysTick；再唤醒CPU2。
423: 9. 两核恢复NVIC和驱动callback，`pm_idle()`完成restore并恢复heartbeat。
424: 
425: 低压时间基准不能继续完全依赖core-clock SysTick。增加BK7258 strong
426: `up_timer_gettick()`/`up_timer_gettime()`，以AON RTC构建64位单调epoch；当前原厂启用
427: 64-bit AON counter，应使用稳定的low/high重读算法，不需要软件扩展32-bit wrap。必须由
428: CP契约确认32 kHz源是32000还是32768 Hz，并用64位算术换算、校准和验证回卷单调性。
429: 
430: 时间读取本身不是唤醒源。P1必须提供下一NuttX deadline的AON/CP wake：推荐启用
431: `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS=y`，实现完整的 `up_timer_tick_cancel()`/
432: `up_timer_tick_start()` 或 `up_alarm_cancel()`/`up_alarm_start()` AON compare backend。
433: 若暂时保持periodic语义，则必须编程AON wake不晚于下一1 ms tick，收益有限。恢复时先
434: 确认clock稳定，再重启SysTick；解除PM barrier前必须让logical CPU0至少执行一次timer
435: processing，使低压期间到期的sleep和watchdog立即得到处理。
436: 
437: 在 AON-backed monotonic time、双核 barrier和驱动 PM callback完成前，禁止打开 P1。
438: 
439: ### 5.3 Deep sleep
440: 
441: Deep sleep定义为 AP 上下文丢失后的完整重启，不是 NuttX suspend-to-RAM：
442: 
443: - CPU1/CPU2、NuttX heap、scheduler、Mailbox transport和PSRAM对象均视为丢失。
444: - CP/bootloader重新启动 CPU1，CPU1重新启动 CPU2。
445: - PSRAM generation必须变化，旧对象不可复用。
446: - 不承诺从原 PC/任务现场继续运行。
447: 
448: ## 6. NuttX SMP 芯片层实现
449: 
450: ### 6.1 配置硬门禁
451: 
452: AP defconfig目标配置：
453: 
454: ```text
455: CONFIG_ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU=y
456: CONFIG_SMP=y
457: CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2
458: CONFIG_SMP_DEFAULT_CPUSET=0x3
459: CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK=2048
460: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
461: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
462: CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y
463: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
464: CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000
465: # CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS is not set
466: ```
467: 
468: 上述是S0-S4/P0配置。P1另增加：
469: 
470: ```text
471: CONFIG_PM=y
472: CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3
473: CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0
474: CONFIG_PM_GOVERNOR_GREEDY=y
475: CONFIG_PM_GOVERNOR_EXPLICIT_RELAX=0
476: CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS=y

478: 
479: `ARCH_CHIP_BK7258` 增加：
480: 
481: ```kconfig
482: select ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU
483: select ARCH_IDLE_CUSTOM
484: select LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK if SMP
485: ```
486: 
487: `ARCH_IDLE_CUSTOM` 必须同时对Make和CMake生效，使公共 `arm_idle.c` 不进入构建；否则
488: `bk7258_idle.c` 与公共实现会重复定义 `up_idle()`。
489: 
490: `board/beken/chips/bk7258/Kconfig:15-17` 的 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 默认值从
491: `120000000` 改为 `480000000`。`bk7258_timerisr.c:16` 直接引用该宏传递给
492: `systick_initialize()`，无需额外修改 timerisr 源码。
493: 
494: 最终 `.config` 必须确认 `clock_t` 为64位、toolchain atomic没有绕过 BK7258 backend、
495: CPU数为2。禁止只修改生成的 `.config`；必须修改项目 defconfig并执行 distclean。
496: 
497: ### 6.2 文件与构建接入
498: 
499: 建议最小新增：
500: 
501: ```text

503:   bk7258_cpustart.c       # secondary vector、reset、online handshake
504:   bk7258_cpuindex.c       # logical CPU ID
505:   bk7258_cpuidlestack.c   # secondary idle stack
506:   bk7258_idle.c           # P0 WFI；P1调用NuttX pm_idle
507:   bk7258_smpcall.c        # raw Mailbox IPI
508:   bk7258_hwspinlock.c     # AP_SPINLOCK software gate
509:   bk7258_atomic.c         # g_atomic_hwspinlock
510: ```
511: 
512: 修改：
513: 
514: ```text
515: Kconfig
516: CMakeLists.txt
517: Make.defs
518: bk7258_start.c
519: bk7258_vectors.c
520: bk7258_irq.c
521: bk7258_timerisr.c
522: bk7258_mbox0.c
523: bk7258_mailbox_channel.c
524: hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h
525: hardware/bk7258_mbox.h
526: board scripts/ld.script
527: board configs/nsh/defconfig

529: 
530: Make和CMake必须包含同一组SMP源文件，并仅在 `CONFIG_SMP` 下编译专用对象。
531: 
532: ### 6.3 CPU ID
533: 
534: 原厂 AP 使用每核私有 DTCM地址 `0x20000000` 保存 AP逻辑核 ID。OpenVela采用：
535: 
536: ```text
537: 物理CPU1私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU0
538: 物理CPU2私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU1
539: ```
540: 
541: `up_cpu_index()` 直接读取该word。primary在任何 per-CPU/NuttX atomic调用前写0；
542: secondary在任何NuttX API前写1。必须实板验证两核看到的是私有实例，不是共享word。
543: 
544: ### 6.4 内存、secondary vector和栈
545: 
546: 分区保持：
547: 
548: ```text
549: AP_SPINLOCK  0x28000000..0x2800ffff
550: AP_RAM       0x28010000..0x28063fff
551: CP_RAM       0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
552: PWR_MNG      0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
553: SWAP         0x2809f800..0x2809ffff
554: ```
555: 
556: CPU2不增加Flash/RAM分区。链接脚本增加：
557: 
558: - `SPINLOCK` MEMORY，绝不加入heap。
559: - 512字节对齐的 `.bk_secondary_vectors`。
560: - 只用于reset早期的CPU2 bootstrap stack。
561: - 两份静态 interrupt stack，或等价的每核固定中断栈区域。
562: - 全部边界和对齐 `ASSERT`。
563: 
564: secondary vector：
565: 
566: ```text
567: word 0: CPU2 bootstrap MSP top
568: word 1: bk7258_secondary_start | 1
569: ```
570: 
571: CPU2 boot offset寄存器只保存地址高24位，至少要求256字节对齐；统一采用512字节以
572: 满足VTOR约束。secondary vector不包含primary image offset `0x100` 的BK legacy magic。
573: 
574: `up_cpu_idlestack()` 应像RP2040一样调用 `up_create_stack()`，初始化logical CPU1 idle
575: TCB。还必须分配 `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS * INTSTACK_SIZE` 对齐空间并实现
576: `uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu)`；公共ARM实现只覆盖UP构建，ARMv8-M任务初始状态
577: 会调用该hook。CPU2 reset后先用bootstrap MSP；进入NuttX前将PSP切到idle TCB stack
578: top，调用 `arm_initialize_stack()` 安装本核MSP/MSPLIM interrupt stack。两个核不得共用
579: MSP。
580: 
581: ### 6.5 CPU2启动
582: 
583: `up_cpu_start(1)`：
584: 
585: ```text
586: 校验cpu==1且当前为logical CPU0
587:   -> 确认CP的OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold和domain readback均为ON
588:   -> 确认480 MHz契约和channel 2已配置
589:   -> 发布idle PSP、interrupt MSP、runtime VTOR
590:   -> 清boot stage/online flag，DMB/DSB
591:   -> CPU2保持reset时清route/pending
592:   -> CPU2_RXEVT_SEL=1
593:   -> CPU2_OFFSET=secondary_vector>>8
594:   -> cpu2_release_reset()（极性已由run-status/实板验证）
595:   -> 有界等待online和双向IPI自检
596: ```
597: 
598: 超时建议500 ms，输出CPU2 control、run status、route、NVIC、Mailbox channel 2、boot
599: stage和当前频率readback，然后panic。不能只返回错误后继续 `nx_bringup()`。
600: 
601: `bk7258_secondary_start()` 只初始化每核私有状态：
602: 
603: - logical ID、FPU CP10/11和barrier。
604: - 与primary一致的SAU/MPU/VTOR。
605: - CPU2私有NVIC enable/pending/priority。
606: - CPU2 Mailbox route和IRQ79。
607: - PSP/MSP/stack limit。
608: - release-ordered online flag、可选的 `sched_note_cpu_started(this_task())`、
609:   `nx_idle_trampoline()`。
610: 
611: primary以acquire语义等待online flag。`sched_note_cpu_started()`只是可选trace，在note
612: driver未启用时为空，不能承担online handshake。
613: 
614: secondary禁止复制 `.data`、清 `.bss`、初始化heap/PSRAM/driver、调用 `nx_start()`、
615: 初始化第二个SysTick或重置全局Mailbox FIFO。
616: 
617: ### 6.6 每核MPU/NVIC
618: 
619: MPU、SAU、NVIC、VTOR、SysTick和FPU控制均为每核私有。CPU2必须安装与CPU1相同的：
620: 
621: - AP Flash RO/X。
622: - AP RAM RW/XN/shareable。
623: - `AP_SPINLOCK` RW/XN/non-cacheable/shareable。
624: - CP共享窗口和Mailbox UART override。
625: - PSRAM 16 MiB RW/XN/non-cacheable。
626: - peripheral Device/XN。
627: 
628: 当前 CPU1 使用7个 MPU region；增加 AP_SPINLOCK 后至少需要8个，启动时继续读
629: `MPU_TYPE.DREGION`并 fail-stop。CPU2不能重复probe或初始化PSRAM allocator。
630: 
631: 全局NuttX IRQ table只由primary初始化一次。CPU2只初始化私有NVIC和CPU2 route：
632: 
633: ```text
634: CPU1 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010088 / 0x4401008c
635: CPU2 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010090 / 0x44010094
636: ```
637: 
638: 首版只有CPU2 Mailbox IPI路由到CPU2。GPIO、PWM、I2C、QSPI、camera、Wi-Fi和其他
639: 有状态外设仍由logical CPU0 owner。
640: 
641: ## 7. Mailbox IPI与CP transport共存
642: 
643: ### 7.1 物理channel
644: 
645: | channel | owner | FIFO |
646: | ---: | --- | --- |
647: | 0 | CPU0/CP | start 0, length 2 |
648: | 1 | CPU1/AP primary | start 2, length 3 |
649: | 2 | CPU2/AP secondary | start 5, length 3 |
650: 
651: 沿用原厂消息分类：
652: 
653: ```text
654: data[1] != 0: pointer + length envelope，进入CP/AP logical transport
655: data[1] == 0: AP内部raw command，进入SMP IPI handler
656: ```
657: 
658: CPU2不处理CP PWC、heartbeat、Wi-Fi或Mailbox UART envelope。CP transport始终由
659: logical CPU0负责。
660: 
661: ### 7.2 当前初始化路径的改造
662: 
663: 当前 physical Mailbox 已在 `arm_serialinit()` 中经：
664: 
665: ```text
666: bk7258_mailbox_init()
667: bk7258_mb_uart_init()
668: bk7258_mailbox_start()
669: ```
670: 
671: 启动。这发生在 `nx_smp_start()` 之前，生命周期适合SMP。改造要求：
672: 
673: 1. primary physical start一次性配置channel 1和2 FIFO，不能在CPU2 online后soft reset。
674: 2. 全局 `irq_attach(79, ...)` 只执行一次；CPU2复用共享NuttX IRQ handler table，但启用
675:    自己的route和私有NVIC line 63。
676: 3. ISR按 `up_cpu_index()` 选择本核physical channel。
677: 4. channel 1可处理CP envelope和raw IPI；channel 2只接受raw IPI。
678: 5. shared transport状态从仅 `up_irq_save()` 改为SMP spinlock，或严格固定到CPU0。
679: 
680: ### 7.3 NuttX SMP hooks
681: 
682: 实现：
683: 
684: ```c
685: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu);
686: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset);
687: ```
688: 
689: raw command采用pending bitmap合并 `SCHED`、`CALL`和 `PM`。发送前DMB，ISR读取并清
690: pending后DMB，然后调用：
691: 
692: ```c
693: nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg);
694: nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu());
695: ```
696: 
697: FIFO full不能静默丢失。采用“shared pending bit + kick”语义：消息只负责唤醒，真实
698: 工作由pending bit保持；如果目标已有未处理kick，不重复占FIFO。发送失败需要有界重试、
699: 计数和fatal门限，禁止持有目标ISR需要的spinlock时无限等待。
700: 
701: ## 8. Atomic、spinlock和共享驱动
702: 
703: ### 8.1 BK7258约束
704: 
705: 原厂注释明确：BK7258 AP SMP只有两个exclusive monitor；两个CPU同时对普通SRAM做
706: exclusive访问时，第三方DMA/Audio写SRAM可能无提示失败。因此原厂把所有spinlock对象
707: 集中在 `AP_SPINLOCK` 特殊SRAM区。
708: 
709: `AP_SPINLOCK`不是寄存器型硬件spinlock。首版使用一个位于该区的software gate，
710: 通过LDAXR/STXR仲裁NuttX `atomic_*` 和libc out-of-line atomic helper：
711: 
712: ```text
713: CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK=y
714: g_atomic_hwspinlock -> struct hwspinlock_dev_s -> BK7258 software gate
715: ```
716: 
717: gate owner使用 `logical_cpu + 1`，0表示free，避免CPU0 owner和free混淆。trylock使用
718: acquire exclusive，unlock使用release store、DSB和SEV。primary在进入 `nx_start()` 前
719: 初始化gate；CPU2启动后禁止再次清零。
720: 
721: 这不会自动拦截编译器内联 `__atomic_*`、`__sync_*` 或手写exclusive loop。SMP源码禁止
722: 直接使用这些路径，构建时反汇编全部SMP对象，除approved gate外发现LDREX/STREX或
723: LDAXR/STXR循环即失败。只有DMA/Audio/exclusive压力通过后才能评估更细粒度方案。
724: 
725: ### 8.2 驱动收敛
726: 
727: 首版将以下worker和IRQ固定到logical CPU0：
728: 
729: - Mailbox transport/UART/syslog/PWC/heartbeat。
730: - Wi-Fi、camera、QSPI、DMA和媒体worker。
731: - GPIO、button/motor、PWM、I2C。
732: - 所有未完成SMP审计的board driver。
733: 
734: worker入口在访问任何driver状态前先构造 `CPU_ZERO/CPU_SET(0)` mask，并调用
735: `sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpu_set_t), &cpuset)`；成功后才通知creator ready。creator
736: 等待该ready，affinity失败则driver bring-up失败。不能在 `kthread_create()` 返回后才pin，
737: 因为worker可能已经运行。
738: 
739: 即使worker固定CPU0，CPU2任务仍可能调用公共API。以下共享状态必须使用
740: `spin_lock_irqsave()` 或mutex：
741: 
742: - Mailbox active transaction、ACK pool、recovery epoch和ring index。
743: - syslog/serial TX/RX ring。
744: - GPIO/PWM/I2C寄存器RMW。
745: - PSRAM allocator状态、allocation counters和generation。
746: - Wi-Fi command/data slot和pbuf ownership。
747: 
748: ISR共享短状态使用spinlock；会等待ACK、semaphore、内存或格式化日志的路径使用mutex，
749: 禁止在spinlock内sleep。
750: 
751: ## 9. 系统tick、heartbeat与时间正确性
752: 
753: 首版只有logical CPU0启动SysTick。CPU2不得调用 `up_timer_initialize()`，否则系统时间
754: 和RR accounting加倍。CPU0每tick调用NuttX timer处理，调度器通过IPI要求CPU2切换。
755: 
756: 必须满足：
757: 
758: - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`。
759: - CPU1实际频率和 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000` 一致。
760: - 60秒wall clock测试误差在晶振/调度允许范围内，不能出现2倍或1/2倍。
761: - heartbeat实际周期约2秒，不是4秒。
762: - heartbeat发送返回值必须检查并统计 `-EBUSY`、`-ENOLINK`、timeout。
763: - CP heartbeat使用实际 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 配置；timeout至少容纳调度抖动和一次transport
764:   recovery，但不能用增大timeout掩盖lost heartbeat。
765: 
766: 长期测试必须跨越旧故障边界：至少运行3小时；正式验收运行24小时。还应通过调试构建
767: 把timer timebase置于旧的 `UINT32_MAX / 1000` 边界前，快速验证sleep跨界。
768: 
769: ## 10. 分阶段实施
770: 
771: ### S0：先修复单核时间和480 MHz契约
772: 
773: 1. AP defconfig 增加 `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`，保持单核 `CONFIG_SMP` 关闭。
774: 2. AP `Kconfig` 将 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 默认值改为 `480000000`。
775: 3. CP增加 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` 和单一boot transaction owner；在任何AP power-on
776:    前写 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1=PM_CPU_FRQ_480M`，保留默认60M slot，并显式写CPU1 exit-sleep。
777: 4. 修复DVFS子函数错误传播、bus divider写入/readback和CPU/PSRAM联合VDDDIG下限；把CP
778:    boot PSRAM和OpenVela PWC纳入独立owner accounting并透传真实初始化错误。
779: 5. CP 修正 `mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` 的 watchdog 配置符号从 `CONFIG_WDT_EN` 改为实际
780:    `CONFIG_INT_WDT`，使 timeout 正确反映 `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS`。
781: 6. 增加CP全部frequency owner、source/divider/speed/voltage/power/PSRAM readback诊断。
782: 7. AP heartbeat worker 检查 `bk7258_mbox_send_message()` 返回值，记录 `-EBUSY`、
783:    `-ENOLINK` 和 transport timeout 计数。
784: 
785: 退出条件：20次冷启动、60秒时间校准、3小时静置无heartbeat timeout；PM slot/cache和
786: 实际寄存器一致，CPU0=240 MHz、CPU1=480 MHz、CPU2 speed字段为480 MHz目标，bus经
787: divider readback和外部测量确认为240 MHz，无320M clamp；PSRAM ON/OFF故障注入不会发布
788: 虚假ready或把VDDDIG降到有效owner要求以下。
789: 
790: ### S1：SMP编译与内存骨架
791: 
792: 1. 先增加CPU ID、每核interrupt stack、`up_get_intstackbase()` 和secondary idle stack，
793:    并提供可链接的 `up_cpu_start()` fail-stop占位及 `up_send_smp_sched()`/
794:    `up_send_smp_call()` 占位，再打开SMP配置。
795: 2. 增加SPINLOCK MEMORY和atomic backend。
796: 3. 增加secondary vector和链接断言，暂不release CPU2。
797: 4. 增加P0 `up_idle()` 普通WFI；两核MPU表增加AP_SPINLOCK和相同PSRAM属性。
798: 
799: 退出条件：clean build通过但该产物不启动；map、vector、stack、gate和heap边界全部正确；
800: 反汇编确认exclusive loop只存在于approved gate，P0 idle object确实包含 `DSB/WFI/ISB`。
801: S2/S3分别替换上述fail-stop和IPI占位实现后才允许烧录启动。
802: 
803: ### S2：CPU2启动到idle
804: 
805: 1. CP通过OpenVela power-only hold在AP生命周期内保持CPU2 domain ON，并在handoff前
806:    保持经验证的reset状态；CP不调用原厂 `start_cpu2_core()`。
807: 2. AP实现语义化CPU2 reset helper、private arch init、stack切换和release/acquire online
808:    handshake，且不写CPU2 power-domain控制位。
809: 3. CPU2只运行NuttX idle，不路由普通外设。
810: 
811: 退出条件：100次冷启动，CPU2每次500 ms内online；任何失败都fail-stop且有寄存器诊断。
812: 
813: ### S3：IPI与调度
814: 
815: 1. 配置channel 2 FIFO和per-core IRQ79。
816: 2. 实现pending-bit raw IPI、`up_send_smp_sched/call`。
817: 3. 完成双向call、task migration、semaphore/mutex和atomic压力。
818: 
819: 退出条件：两核100%负载1小时，无lost IPI、死锁、counter mismatch和heartbeat timeout。
820: 
821: ### S4：恢复驱动
822: 
823: 1. worker/IRQ固定CPU0。
824: 2. 审计Mailbox、syslog、GPIO/PWM/I2C、PSRAM、Wi-Fi和camera共享状态。
825: 3. 依次恢复console、PWC/heartbeat、PSRAM、GPIO/PWM、Wi-Fi和camera。
826: 
827: 退出条件：单核已有功能全部回归，CPU2压力不影响CP transport和外设owner。
828: 
829: ### P1：低压睡眠
830: 
831: 1. 启用NuttX PM SMP框架、三个domain、logical CPU0 last-CPU和driver callback。
832: 2. 实现AON-backed 64位monotonic time及tickless AON compare/deadline wake backend。
833: 3. 在 `pm_idle(handler)` 内实现双核AON WFI bit和CP sleep vote协议。
834: 4. CP只在AP双方确认后进入low-voltage，寄存器确认恢复480 MHz/bus后再唤醒AP。
835: 5. 完成expired timer处理、heartbeat宽限和Mailbox恢复。
836: 
837: 退出条件：10000次低压进出、短/长timer deadline、RTC/GPIO wakeup、双核负载与故障
838: 注入全部通过；sleep/watchdog不晚触发，monotonic time不倒退。
839:

904: 
905: ## 12. 实板验证矩阵
906: 
907: | 测试 | 方法 | 通过标准 |
908: | --- | --- | --- |
909: | 480 MHz契约 | CP读取全部vote、source、core/bus divider、三个CPU speed、VDDD/VDDDIG | slot/cache/寄存器一致；CPU0=240、AP=480、bus实测240；无320M clamp |
910: | wall clock | 对比外部计时60秒/1小时 | 无2倍或1/2倍走时 |
911: | heartbeat | 记录1000个间隔 | 约2秒，发送失败有统计，无CP timeout |
912: | 旧回卷边界 | debug seed + 3小时静置 | sleep继续唤醒，无时间倒退和assert |
913: | CPU ID | affinity任务读取 `sched_getcpu()` | 分别稳定为0、1 |
914: | CPU2启动 | 100次冷启动 | 全部500 ms内online |
915: | 双向IPI | CPU0->CPU1和CPU1->CPU0 | callback CPU和次数正确，无lost kick |
916: | task migration | mask 0x3计算任务 | 可迁移且状态完整 |
917: | atomic | 两核各加100万次 | 精确200万 |
918: | DMA+atomic | DMA写普通SRAM并发lock压力 | 无silent DMA write loss |
919: | interrupt stack | 中断嵌套和stack coloration | 两核MSP不重叠、不越界 |
920: | PSRAM | owner/error/电压故障注入及两核并发alloc/free | init失败不置bit/ready；CP owner不被AP OFF误关；VDDDIG不低于0.95 V；generation和计数一致 |
921: | Mailbox | log、PWC、Wi-Fi与IPI并发 | 无ACK覆盖、FIFO死锁、heartbeat丢失 |
922: | 外设owner | GPIO/PWM/I2C/camera/Wi-Fi回归 | IRQ只在logical CPU0，行为与单核一致 |
923: | P0 idle | 两核空闲WFI | 可由SysTick/IPI/Mailbox唤醒，CP不进LV |
924: | P1低压 | 短/长timer deadline及RTC/GPIO唤醒循环 | deadline唤醒不丢失，时间不倒退，480 MHz/bus恢复后再运行AP |
925: | shutdown | 请求AP recovery | park/reset CPU2、释放AP PSRAM owner、关CPU2、关CPU1、最后释放频率slot |
926: 
927: 故障注入：
928: 
929: - CPU2保持reset、secondary vector错位、CPU2 IRQ route屏蔽。
930: - channel 2 FIFO full、丢kick、重复kick、pending bit竞态。
931: - CP拒绝480 MHz、强制320 MHz clamp、readback不一致。
932: - bus divider写失败、切频helper返回错误、PSRAM仍ON时请求降到60 MHz。
933: - heartbeat send返回 `-EBUSY`/`-ENOLINK`。
934: - AP在CPU2未park时请求shutdown。
935: - PSRAM OFFLINE/recovery期间CPU2发起分配。
936: - P1阶段只让一个AP核设置WFI bit，确认CP拒绝进入low-voltage。
937: - P1恢复时暂不恢复480 MHz，确认AP不解除PM barrier。
938: 
939: ## 13. 完成定义
940: 
941: 只有同时满足以下条件才算完成：
942: 
943: 1. 最终包仍只有一个AP `app1.bin`，CPU1/CPU2共享同一个NuttX实例。
944: 2. CP在CPU1 reset前建立并验证480 MHz AP档位，运行期不发生未协调DVFS。
945: 3. `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`，旧的长期静置重启不可复现。
946: 4. CPU2使用独立bootstrap、idle和interrupt stack，private arch状态正确。
947: 5. CPU2启动失败fail-stop，不发送虚假PWC ready。
948: 6. 双向schedule/call IPI无丢失，SMP调度和task migration稳定。
949: 7. AP_SPINLOCK atomic gate通过两核、DMA和外设并发压力。
950: 8. 只有logical CPU0产生系统tick，wall clock和heartbeat周期正确。
951: 9. CP transport和普通外设保持logical CPU0 owner且SMP-safe。
952: 10. CPU2先park/reset，CP依次关闭CPU2/CPU1，最后释放480 MHz slot并重新仲裁VDDDIG。
953: 11. S0-S4完成后通过24小时SMP稳定性测试。
954: 12. P1只有在NuttX SMP PM、AON时间、deadline wake、双核WFI barrier和恢复协议完成后
955:     才标记支持。
956: 
957: ## 14. 实施顺序总结
958: 
959: ```text
960: SYSTEM_TIME64 + CP 480 MHz单一生命周期slot
961:   -> 单核3小时验证
962:   -> SMP配置、AP_SPINLOCK和每核栈
963:   -> CPU2 secondary vector/reset/online
964:   -> channel 2 raw IPI和NuttX SMP hooks
965:   -> driver affinity与共享锁
966:   -> PSRAM/Wi-Fi/camera等功能回归
967:   -> 24小时稳定性
968:   -> AON-backed time和coordinated low-voltage
969: ```
970: 
971: 不要把低压睡眠、runtime DVFS、cacheable PSRAM、CPU2 hotplug和首次SMP启动放进同一
972: 提交。先证明固定480 MHz、64位时间、cache-off、单tick、CPU0外设owner模式下的双核
973: 调度正确，再逐项开放功耗和性能优化。

12: 
13: extern void __start(void);
14: extern void exception_common(void);
15: extern void exception_direct(void);
16: extern uint8_t __idle_stack_top[];
17: 
18: typedef void (*vector_t)(void);
19: 
20: /* CPU0 starts CPU1 at the AP image origin, so this table must remain at raw
21:  * image offset zero. The BK legacy words at 0x100 make it unsuitable as the
22:  * runtime vector table.
23:  */
24: 
25: const vector_t g_bk7258_boot_vectors[NR_IRQS]
26:   __attribute__((used, section(".bk_boot_vectors"), aligned(512))) =
27: {
28:   [0]       = (vector_t)__idle_stack_top,
29:   [1]       = __start,
30:   [2 ... 14] = exception_common,
31:   [15 ... 63] = exception_direct,
32:   [64]      = (vector_t)0x32374b42u,
33:   [65]      = (vector_t)0x00003633u,
34:   [66 ... (NR_IRQS - 1)] = exception_direct,
35: };
36: 
37: /* NuttX exceptions enter through the common ARMv8-M assembly dispatchers.
38:  * This complete table is copied to AP SRAM before interrupts are enabled.
39:  */
40: 
41: const vector_t _vectors[NR_IRQS]
42:   __attribute__((used, section(".ram_vectors"), aligned(512))) =
43: {
44:   [0]       = (vector_t)__idle_stack_top,
45:   [1]       = __start,
46:   [2 ... 14] = exception_common,
47:   [15 ... (NR_IRQS - 1)] = exception_direct,
48: };

53: static int bk7258_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
54:                           uintptr_t offset)

57: 
58:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);

60:   if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
61:     {

63:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(extirq) + offset;
64:       *bit = 1u << (extirq & 31);
65:       return OK;
66:     }
67: 
68:   *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
69:   switch (irq)
70:     {
71:       case BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT:
72:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
73:         break;
74:       case BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT:
75:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
76:         break;
77:       case BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT:
78:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
79:         break;
80:       case BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT:
81:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA;
82:         break;
83:       case BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK:
84:         *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;
85:         *bit = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE;
86:         break;
87:       default:
88:         return ERROR;
89:     }
90: 
91:   return OK;

98:   regval |= priority << NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_SHIFT;

104:   uintptr_t regaddr;

106:   int i;
107: 
108:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_EXTIRQ_COUNT; i += 32)
109:     {

111:     }

113:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0);

116:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);

128:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SVCALL, arm_svcall, NULL);
129:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_HARDFAULT, arm_hardfault, NULL);
130:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
131:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT, arm_busfault, NULL);
132:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT, arm_usagefault, NULL);
133:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT, arm_securefault, NULL);
134:   arm_enable_dbgmonitor();
135:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_DBGMONITOR, arm_dbgmonitor, NULL);

137:   bk7258_prioritize_svcall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
138:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT);
139:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT);
140:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT);

7: /* g_bk7258_boot_vectors and _vectors (bk7258_vectors.c) are matched into
8:  * the .bk_boot_vectors / .ram_vectors output sections below purely by
9:  * input section name.  Nothing in the C code references either symbol
10:  * directly, so without this EXTERN() the linker never has a reason to
11:  * pull bk7258_vectors.o out of libarch.a in the first place: KEEP() only
12:  * protects sections that are already part of the link from
13:  * --gc-sections, it does not force extraction of an otherwise-unused
14:  * static archive member.  Without this, both output sections silently
15:  * come out empty (verified via nuttx.map) and the boot/runtime vector
16:  * tables are missing at runtime, not just failing the size ASSERT below.
17:  */
18: EXTERN(g_bk7258_boot_vectors)
19: EXTERN(_vectors)
20: 
21: MEMORY
22: {
23:   FLASH (rx)  : ORIGIN = 0x02150000, LENGTH = 0x00110000
24:   RAM   (rwx) : ORIGIN = 0x28010000, LENGTH = 0x00054000
25:   SWAP  (rw)  : ORIGIN = 0x2809f800, LENGTH = 0x00000800
26:   PSRAM_SECTION (rw) : ORIGIN = 0x60a00000, LENGTH = 0x00600000
27: }
28: 
29: __ap_ram_start = ORIGIN(RAM);
30: __ap_ram_end = ORIGIN(RAM) + LENGTH(RAM);
31: 
32: SECTIONS
33: {
34:   .bk_boot_vectors ORIGIN(FLASH) : ALIGN(512)
35:   {
36:     KEEP(*(.bk_boot_vectors))
37:   } > FLASH
38: 
39:   .gnu.sgstubs : ALIGN(32)
40:   {
41:     KEEP(*(.gnu.sgstubs*))

44:   .text : ALIGN(4)
45:   {
46:     _stext = .;
47:     KEEP(*(.start_text))
48:     *(.text .text.*)
49:     *(.rodata .rodata.*)
50:     KEEP(*(.init))

55:   .init_array : ALIGN(4)

60:     __init_array_end = .;
61:   } > FLASH

63:   .ARM.extab : ALIGN(4)

66:   } > FLASH
67: 
68:   __exidx_start = .;
69:   .ARM.exidx : ALIGN(4)
70:   {
71:     *(.ARM.exidx* .gnu.linkonce.armexidx.*)
72:   } > FLASH
73:   __exidx_end = .;
74: 
75:   .data : ALIGN(8)
76:   {
77:     _sdata = .;
78:     *(.data .data.* .sdata .sdata.*)
79:     _edata = .;
80:   } > RAM AT > FLASH
81:   _eronly = LOADADDR(.data);
82: 
83:   .ram_vectors : ALIGN(512)
84:   {
85:     __ram_vectors_start = .;
86:     KEEP(*(.ram_vectors))
87:     __ram_vectors_end = .;
88:   } > RAM AT > FLASH
89:   __ram_vectors_load = LOADADDR(.ram_vectors);
90: 
91:   .bss (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
92:   {
93:     _sbss = .;
94:     *(.bss .bss.* .sbss .sbss.*)
95:     *(COMMON)
96:     _ebss = .;
97:   } > RAM
98: 
99:   .noinit (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
100:   {
101:     *(.noinit .noinit.*)
102:   } > RAM
103: 
104:   .idle_stack (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
105:   {
106:     __idle_stack_base = .;
107:     . += 0x1000;
108:     __idle_stack_top = .;
109:   } > RAM
110: 
111:   .swap (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(32)
112:   {
113:     __swap_start = .;
114:     KEEP(*(.swap .swap.*))
115:     __swap_end = ORIGIN(SWAP) + LENGTH(SWAP);
116:   } > SWAP
117: 
118:   .psram.data : ALIGN(8)
119:   {
120:     __ap_psram_data_start = .;
121:     *(.psram.data .psram.data.*)
122:     __ap_psram_data_end = .;
123:   } > PSRAM_SECTION AT > FLASH
124: 
125:   .psram.bss (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
126:   {
127:     __ap_psram_bss_start = .;
128:     *(.psram.bss .psram.bss.*)
129:     __ap_psram_bss_end = .;
130:   } > PSRAM_SECTION
131: 
132:   .psram.noinit (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
133:   {
134:     __ap_psram_noinit_start = .;
135:     *(.psram.noinit .psram.noinit.*)
136:     __ap_psram_noinit_end = .;
137:   } > PSRAM_SECTION
138: 
139:   __ap_psram_section_start = ORIGIN(PSRAM_SECTION);
140:   __ap_psram_section_end = ORIGIN(PSRAM_SECTION) + LENGTH(PSRAM_SECTION);

142:   __heap_start = ALIGN(ADDR(.idle_stack) + SIZEOF(.idle_stack), 8);

144:   _eram = __ap_ram_end;

147:   {
148:     *(.note .note.*)
149:     *(.comment)

165:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
166: 
167:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
168: }
169: 
170: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
171: {
172:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
173:   unsigned int i;
174: 
175:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
176:     {
177:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
178: 
179:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
180:         {
181:           continue;
182:         }
183: 
184:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
185:         {
186:           oldest = desc;
187:         }
188:     }
189: 
190:   return oldest;
191: }
192: 
193: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
194: {
195:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
196:   int ret;
197: 
198:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
199:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
200:    */
201: 
202:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
203:     {
204:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
205:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
206:       g_processing_order = 0;
207:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
208:         {
209:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
210:           break;
211:         }
212: 
213:       desc->used = false;
214:     }
215: 
216:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
217:     {
218:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
219:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
220:       g_processing_order = 0;
221:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
222:         {
223:           break;
224:         }
225: 
226:       desc->used = false;
227:     }
228: }
229: 
230: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
231: {
232:   (void)irq;
233:   (void)context;
234:   (void)arg;
235: 
236:   mbox_clear_errors();
237: 
238:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
239:     {
240:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
241:       uint32_t address;
242:       uint32_t length;
243:       uint8_t source;
244: 
245:       mbox_process_desc();
246:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
247:       if (desc == NULL)
248:         {
249:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
250:           break;
251:         }
252: 
253:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
254:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
255:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
256:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
257:         {
258:           continue;
259:         }
260: 
261:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
262:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
263:              sizeof(desc->message));
264:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
265:       desc->used = true;
266:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
267:       mbox_process_desc();
268:     }
269: 
270:   mbox_process_desc();
271: 
272:   return OK;
273: }
274: 
275: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
276: {
277:   g_callback = callback;
278: }
279: 
280: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
281: {
282:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
283: 
284:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
285:   up_irq_restore(flags);
286: }
287: 
288: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
289: {
290:   unsigned int i;
291: 
292:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
293:     {
294:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
295:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
296:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
297:         {
298:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
299:         }
300:     }
301: }
302: 
303: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
304: {
305:   irqstate_t flags;
306: 
307:   if (stats == NULL)
308:     {
309:       return;
310:     }
311: 
312:   flags = up_irq_save();
313:   *stats = g_stats;
314:   up_irq_restore(flags);
315: }
316: 
317: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
318: {
319:   int ret;
320: 
321:   if (g_mbox_ready)
322:     {
323:       return OK;
324:     }
325: 
326:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
327:   g_rx_order = 0;
328:   g_processing_order = 0;
329:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
330: 
331:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
332:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
333:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
334:    */
335: 
336:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
337:            MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
338:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
339:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
340:   mbox_clear_errors();
341: 
342:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
343:   if (ret < 0)
344:     {
345:       return ret;
346:     }
347: 
348:   g_mbox_ready = true;
349:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
350:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
351:   return OK;
352: }

7: #ifndef __VENDOR_BEKEN_CHIPS_BK7258_HARDWARE_BK7258_SYSCTRL_H
8: #define __VENDOR_BEKEN_CHIPS_BK7258_HARDWARE_BK7258_SYSCTRL_H
9: 
10: #include "bk7258_memorymap.h"
11: 
12: #define BK7258_SYS_CLKDIV1        (BK7258_SYSCTRL_BASE + 0x20u)
13: #define BK7258_SYS_DEVCLK_EN      (BK7258_SYSCTRL_BASE + 0x30u)
14: #define BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0       (BK7258_SYSCTRL_BASE + 0x88u)
15: #define BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1       (BK7258_SYSCTRL_BASE + 0x8cu)
16: #define BK7258_GPIO_FUNC0         (BK7258_SYSCTRL_BASE + 0xc0u)
17: 
18: #define BK7258_UART1_CLKDIV_SHIFT 11
19: #define BK7258_UART1_CLKDIV_MASK  (3u << BK7258_UART1_CLKDIV_SHIFT)
20: #define BK7258_UART1_CLKSEL       (1u << 13)
21: #define BK7258_UART1_CLK_EN       (1u << 10)
22: #define BK7258_UART1_IRQ_ROUTE    (1u << 15)
23: 
24: /* BK7258_SYS_DEVCLK_EN bit[8]: "i2c1_clk enable" per
25:  * bk_avdk_smp release/v3.1.1
26:  * ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sys_types.h's register map comment
27:  * block (register word index 0xc, i.e. byte offset 0xc*4=0x30 from
28:  * BK7258_SYSCTRL_BASE -- matching BK7258_SYS_DEVCLK_EN's existing
29:  * offset, and independently cross-checked by BK7258_UART1_CLK_EN
30:  * above already using bit[10] for the same register's documented
31:  * "uart1_clk enable" bit).  This is the *module* clock gate for the
32:  * hardware I2C1 peripheral (SOC_I2C1_REG_BASE) -- distinct from
33:  * sm_bus_cfg.freq_div (the I2C *bus* baud-rate divider) and
34:  * global_ctrl.clk_gate_bypass (an internal I2C1-block clock-gate
35:  * bypass for reading the ack bit).  Without this bit set, register
36:  * writes to the I2C1 block still land in mock/real memory (no bus
37:  * fault), but the state machine never actually runs: START never
38:  * produces any sm_int, exactly matching this driver's observed board
39:  * bring-up symptom (int_status stuck at only the start bit set,
40:  * sm_int never firing) before this bit was added to
41:  * bk7258_i2c1_init(). */
42: #define BK7258_I2C1_MODULE_CLK_EN (1u << 8)
43: 
44: /* BK7258_SYS_DEVCLK_EN bit[20]/bit[21]: "qspi0_clk enable"/"qspi1_clk
45:  * enable" per the same bk_avdk_smp release/v3.1.1
46:  * ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sys_types.h register map comment block
47:  * used to derive BK7258_I2C1_MODULE_CLK_EN above (source lines:
48:  * "0xc[20],1:qspi0_clk enable,0,R/W" and "0xc[21],1:qspi1_clk enable,0,R/W").
49:  * This is the *module* clock gate for the QSPI0/QSPI1 controller blocks --
50:  * distinct from qspi_hw_t's own glb_ctrl.soft_reset/bps_clkgate fields
51:  * (which bk7258_qspi.c already touches) and from the QSPI_CLK_320M/480M
52:  * source-clock-select + divider path (sys_drv_qspi_clk_sel()/
53:  * sys_drv_qspi_set_src_clk_div() in
54:  * ap/middleware/driver/qspi/qspi_driver.c, not yet ported to this repo).
55:  * bk7258_qspi.c's original implementation never set this bit -- discovered
56:  * while diagnosing GC9D01's persistent "cmd 0xFE timed out" symptom after
57:  * the QSPI0->QSPI1 pin-routing fix alone did not resolve it, by
58:  * cross-referencing qspi_id_init_common()'s documented call order ("1. set
59:  * clock, 2. set gpio as qspi, 3. enable interrupt") against this driver's
60:  * qspi0_init(), which only did step 2.  Same failure signature as
61:  * BK7258_I2C1_MODULE_CLK_EN's documented symptom applies here by analogy

40:  * designer's arbitrary connector-pin numbering convention, not a

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 Mailbox V2 logical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdio.h>
10: #include <stdint.h>
11: #include <syslog.h>
12: #include <string.h>
13: 
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
16: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
17: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
18: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
19: 
20: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
21: 
22: #define MB_CHANNEL_COUNT       5u
23: #define MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT    3u
24: #define MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT      8u
25: #define MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER      3u
26: #define MB_TIMEOUT             MSEC2TICK(200)
27: #define MB_WORK_INTERVAL       MSEC2TICK(10)
28: #define MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS  3u
29: #define MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT 4u
30: #define MB_DOWN_RETRY          MSEC2TICK(100)
31: 
32: enum ack_slot_state
33: {
34:   ACK_SLOT_FREE = 0,
35:   ACK_SLOT_QUEUED,
36:   ACK_SLOT_SENT
37: };
38: 
39: struct logical_channel
40: {
41:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message pending;
42:   bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback;
43:   void *arg;
44:   int result;
45:   bool queued;
46: };
47: 
48: struct active_transaction
49: {
50:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
51:   bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback;
52:   void *arg;
53:   clock_t started;
54:   uint32_t order;
55:   uint8_t channel_index;
56:   bool busy;
57:   bool quarantine;
58: };
59: 
60: struct ack_slot
61: {
62:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
63:   uint32_t order;
64:   enum ack_slot_state state;
65: };
66: 
67: struct recovery_epoch
68: {
69:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message reset __attribute__((aligned(32)));
70:   struct active_transaction probe;
71:   uint32_t reset_order;
72:   uint32_t first_probe_order;
73:   bool reset_sent;
74:   bool replay;
75: };
76: 
77: struct transport_stats
78: {
79:   uint32_t tx;
80:   uint32_t rx;
81:   uint32_t fifo_full;
82:   uint32_t timeout;
83:   uint32_t bad_ack;
84:   uint32_t bad_header;
85:   uint32_t unsupported;
86:   uint32_t ack_overflow;
87:   uint32_t resets;
88:   uint32_t probes;
89:   uint32_t probe_fail;
90:   uint32_t recovery_cycle;
91:   uint32_t recovery_replay;
92:   uint32_t link_ready;
93:   uint32_t link_down;
94:   uint32_t deferred_command;
95: };
96: 
97: static const uint8_t g_channel_ids[MB_CHANNEL_COUNT] =
98: {
99:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX,
100:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_TX,
101:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_WIFI_CMD_TX,
102:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_WIFI_DATA_TX,
103:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX
104: };
105: 
106: static const uint8_t g_rx_channel_ids[MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT] =
107: {
108:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_WIFI_CMD_RX,
109:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_WIFI_DATA_RX,
110:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX
111: };
112: 
113: static struct logical_channel g_channels[MB_CHANNEL_COUNT];
114: static struct active_transaction g_active;
115: static struct recovery_epoch g_recovery[MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT];
116: static struct ack_slot g_ack_slots[MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT];
117: static struct transport_stats g_stats;
118: static bk7258_mb_channel_rx_t g_rx_callbacks[MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT];
119: static void *g_rx_args[MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT];
120: static void (*g_pwc_rx)(const void *message);
121: static bk7258_mb_link_callback_t g_link_callback;
122: static void *g_link_arg;
123: static sem_t g_tx_sem;
124: static sem_t g_diag_sem;
125: static uint32_t g_send_order;
126: static uint8_t g_tx_seq;
127: static enum bk7258_mb_link_state g_link_state;
128: static bool g_initialized;
129: static bool g_physical_started;
130: static bool g_reset_pending;
131: static bool g_probe_requested;
132: static uint8_t g_probe_attempts;
133: static uint8_t g_recovery_index;
134: static clock_t g_down_since;
135: static enum bk7258_mb_link_state g_diag_state;
136: static uint32_t g_peer_reset_generation;
137: 
138: _Static_assert(MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT >= 2u * 3u + 1u,
139:                "ACK pool must exceed two hardware FIFO depths");
140: _Static_assert(MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT >= 3u,
141:                "at least three stable recovery epochs are required");
142: 
143: static struct recovery_epoch *current_recovery(void)
144: {
145:   return &g_recovery[g_recovery_index];
146: }
147: 
148: static unsigned int channel_index(uint8_t channel)
149: {
150:   unsigned int i;
151: 
152:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
153:     {
154:       if (g_channel_ids[i] == channel)
155:         {
156:           return i;
157:         }
158:     }
159: 
160:   return MB_CHANNEL_COUNT;
161: }
162: 
163: static unsigned int rx_channel_index(uint8_t channel)
164: {
165:   unsigned int i;
166: 
167:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
168:     {
169:       if (g_rx_channel_ids[i] == channel)
170:         {
171:           return i;
172:         }
173:     }
174: 
175:   return MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT;
176: }
177: 
178: static unsigned int ack_slots_used(void)
179: {
180:   unsigned int count = 0;
181:   unsigned int i;
182: 
183:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
184:     {
185:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_FREE)
186:         {
187:           count++;
188:         }
189:     }
190: 
191:   return count;
192: }
193: 
194: static struct active_transaction *busy_probe(void)
195: {
196:   unsigned int i;
197: 
198:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
199:     {
200:       if (g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
201:         {
202:           return &g_recovery[i].probe;
203:         }
204:     }
205: 
206:   return NULL;
207: }
208: 
209: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
210:                      uint32_t *order)
211: {
212:   uint32_t wire[2];
213:   int ret;
214: 
215:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
216:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
217:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
218:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
219:   if (ret == OK)
220:     {
221:       *order = ++g_send_order;
222:       g_stats.tx++;
223:     }
224:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
225:     {
226:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
227:     }
228: 
229:   return ret;
230: }
231: 
232: static void release_acks_before(uint32_t order)
233: {
234:   unsigned int i;
235: 
236:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
237:     {
238:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_SENT &&
239:           g_ack_slots[i].order < order)
240:         {
241:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
242:         }
243:     }
244: }
245: 
246: static void set_link_state(enum bk7258_mb_link_state state)
247: {
248:   if (g_link_state != state)
249:     {
250:       if (state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
251:         {
252:           g_stats.link_ready++;
253:         }
254:       else if (state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN)
255:         {
256:           g_stats.link_down++;
257:           g_down_since = clock_systime_ticks();
258:         }
259: 
260:       g_link_state = state;
261:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
262:       g_diag_state = state;
263:       nxsem_post(&g_diag_sem);
264:     }
265: }
266: 
267: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
268:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
269:                                  int result)
270: {
271:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
272: 
273:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
274:     {
275:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
276:       channel->queued = false;
277:       channel->result = result;
278:     }
279: 
280:   if (active->callback != NULL)
281:     {
282:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
283:     }
284: 
285:   active->busy = false;
286:   if (result == OK)
287:     {
288:       release_acks_before(active->order);
289:     }
290: }
291: 
292: static void fail_pending(int result)
293: {
294:   unsigned int i;
295: 
296:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
297:     {
298:       struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[i];
299: 
300:       if (channel->queued)
301:         {
302:           channel->queued = false;
303:           channel->result = result;
304:           if (channel->callback != NULL)
305:             {
306:               channel->callback(NULL, result, channel->arg);
307:             }
308:         }
309:     }
310: }
311: 
312: static void release_recovery_slots(void)
313: {
314:   unsigned int i;
315: 
316:   g_active.quarantine = false;
317:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
318:     {
319:       memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
320:     }
321: }
322: 
323: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
324: {
325:   unsigned int i;
326:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
327: 
328:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
329:     {
330:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
331:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
332:         {
333:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
334:           g_recovery_index = i;
335:           break;
336:         }
337:     }
338: 
339:   if (epoch == NULL)
340:     {
341:       uint32_t newest = 0;
342: 
343:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
344:         {
345:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
346:             {
347:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
348:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
349:               g_recovery_index = i;
350:             }
351:         }
352: 
353:       epoch->replay = true;
354:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
355:     }
356:   else
357:     {
358:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
359:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
360:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
361:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
362:     }
363: 
364:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
365:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
366:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
367:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
368:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
369: }
370: 
371: static void begin_abort(int result)
372: {
373:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
374: 
375:   if (g_active.busy)
376:     {
377:       g_active.quarantine = true;
378:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
379:     }
380: 
381:   if (probe != NULL)
382:     {
383:       probe->quarantine = true;
384:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
385:     }
386: 
387:   fail_pending(result);
388:   g_probe_requested = false;
389:   select_recovery_epoch();
390: }
391: 
392: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
393: {
394:   unsigned int i;
395: 
396:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
397:     {
398:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
399:         {
400:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
401:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
402:         }
403:     }
404: 
405:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
406:   return NULL;
407: }
408: 
409: static int dispatch_locked(void)
410: {
411:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
412:   struct active_transaction *active;
413:   struct logical_channel *channel;
414:   unsigned int i;
415:   int ret;
416: 
417:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
418: 
419:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
420:     {
421:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
422:         {
423:           continue;
424:         }
425: 
426:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
427:       if (ret < 0)
428:         {
429:           return ret;
430:         }
431: 
432:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
433:     }
434: 
435:   if (g_reset_pending)
436:     {
437:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
438:       if (ret < 0)
439:         {
440:           return ret;
441:         }
442: 
443:       g_reset_pending = false;
444:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
445:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
446:     }
447: 
448:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
449:     {
450:       return OK;
451:     }
452: 
453:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
454:     {
455:       channel = &g_channels[i];
456:       if (!channel->queued)
457:         {
458:           continue;
459:         }
460: 
461:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
462:         {
463:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
464:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
465:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
466:             {
467:               continue;
468:             }
469: 
470:           active = &epoch->probe;
471:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
472:             {
473:               return -ENOLINK;
474:             }
475:         }
476:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
477:         {
478:           active = &g_active;
479:           if (active->quarantine)
480:             {
481:               return -ENOLINK;
482:             }
483:         }
484:       else
485:         {
486:           return OK;
487:         }
488: 
489:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
490:         {
491:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
492:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
493:                  sizeof(active->message));
494:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
495:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
496:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
497:             g_channel_ids[i]);
498:         }
499: 
500:       active->callback = channel->callback;
501:       active->arg = channel->arg;
502:       active->channel_index = i;
503:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
504:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
505:       if (ret < 0)
506:         {
507:           return ret;
508:         }
509: 
510:       active->busy = true;
511:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
512:         {
513:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
514:             {
515:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
516:             }
517: 
518:           g_probe_attempts++;
519:           g_stats.probes++;
520:         }
521: 
522:       return OK;
523:     }
524: 
525:   return OK;
526: }

528: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
529:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
530: {
531:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
532: 
533:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
534:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
535:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
536:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
537:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
538:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
539:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
540: }
541: 
542: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
543: {
544:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
545:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
546:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
547: }
548: 
549: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
550: {
551:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
552:   struct active_transaction *active;
553:   bool replay;
554:   int result;
555: 
556:   active = busy_probe();
557:   if (active == NULL)
558:     {
559:       active = &g_active;
560:     }
561: 
562:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
563:     {
564:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
565:       return;
566:     }
567: 
568:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
569:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
570:     {
571:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
572: 
573:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
574:       return;
575:     }
576: 
577:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
578:     {
579:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
580:       return;
581:     }
582: 
583:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
584:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
585: 
586:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
587:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
588:     {
589:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
590:     }
591: 
592:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
593:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
594:   if (replay)
595:     {
596:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
597:       unsigned int i;
598: 
599:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
600:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
601:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
602:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
603:        */
604: 
605:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
606:       g_active.quarantine = false;
607:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
608:         {
609:           if (i != replay_index)
610:             {
611:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
612:             }
613:         }
614: 
615:       select_recovery_epoch();
616:       (void)dispatch_locked();
617:       return;
618:     }
619: 
620:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
621: 
622:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
623:     {
624:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
625:         {
626:           release_recovery_slots();
627:           g_recovery_index = 0;
628:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
629:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
630:         }
631:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
632:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
633:         {
634:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
635:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
636:            */
637:         }
638:       else
639:         {
640:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
641:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
642:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
643:         }
644:     }
645: 
646:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
647:            result < 0)
648:     {
649:       begin_abort(result);
650:     }
651: 
652:   (void)dispatch_locked();
653: }

655: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
656: {
657:   struct ack_slot *slot;
658:   unsigned int rx_index;
659:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
660:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
661:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
662:   uint8_t state = 0;
663:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
664: 
665:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
666:     {
667:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
668:       if (slot == NULL)
669:         {
670:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
671:           return -EAGAIN;
672:         }
673:     }
674:   else
675:     {
676:       slot = NULL;
677:     }
678: 
679:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
680:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
681:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
682:     {
683:       g_stats.bad_header++;
684:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
685:     }
686:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
687:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
688:     {
689:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
690:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
691:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
692:         {
693:           if (slot != NULL)
694:             {
695:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
696:             }
697: 
698:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
699:           return -EAGAIN;
700:         }
701:       else if (ret < 0)
702:         {
703:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
704:         }
705:     }
706:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
707:     {
708:       g_pwc_rx(message);
709:       ret = OK;
710:     }
711:   else
712:     {
713:       g_stats.unsupported++;
714:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
715:     }
716: 
717:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
718:     {
719:       return OK;
720:     }
721: 
722:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
723:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
724:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
725:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
726:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
727: 
728:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
729:     {
730:       g_probe_requested = true;
731:     }
732: 
733:   (void)dispatch_locked();
734:   return OK;
735: }
736: 
737: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
738: {
739:   irqstate_t flags;
740:   uint8_t control;
741: 
742:   flags = up_irq_save();
743:   g_stats.rx++;
744:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
745: 
746:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
747:     {
748:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
749:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
750:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
751:         {
752:           g_stats.bad_header++;
753:         }
754:       else
755:         {
756:           g_stats.resets++;
757:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
758:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
759:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
760:         }
761:     }
762:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
763:     {
764:       handle_ack(message);
765:     }
766:   else
767:     {
768:       int ret = handle_command(message);
769: 
770:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
771:         {
772:           up_irq_restore(flags);
773:           return ret;
774:         }
775:     }
776: 
777:   up_irq_restore(flags);
778:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
779:   return OK;
780: }

782: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
783: {
784:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
785: 
786:   (void)argc;
787:   (void)argv;
788:   for (;;)
789:     {
790:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
791:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
792:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
793:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
794:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
795:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
796:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
797:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
798: 
799:       up_irq_restore(flags);
800:       if (reported == state)
801:         {
802:           continue;
803:         }
804: 
805:       reported = state;
806:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
807:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
808:         {
809:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
810:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
811:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
812:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
813:         }
814: 
815:       if (callback != NULL)
816:         {
817:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
818:         }
819:     }
820: 
821:   return OK;
822: }

824: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
825: {
826:   (void)argc;
827:   (void)argv;
828: 
829:   for (;;)
830:     {
831:       struct active_transaction *probe;
832:       irqstate_t flags;
833:       bool request_probe;
834: 
835:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
836:       flags = up_irq_save();
837: 
838:       probe = busy_probe();
839:       if ((g_active.busy &&
840:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
841:           (probe != NULL &&
842:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
843:         {
844:           g_stats.timeout++;
845:           if (probe != NULL)
846:             {
847:               probe->quarantine = true;
848:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
849:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
850:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
851:             }
852:           else
853:             {
854:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
855:             }
856:         }
857: 
858:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
859:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
860:         {
861:           select_recovery_epoch();
862:         }
863: 
864:       (void)dispatch_locked();
865:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
866:         {
867:           g_probe_requested = false;
868:         }
869: 
870:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
871:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
872:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
873:       if (request_probe)
874:         {
875:           g_probe_requested = false;
876:         }
877: 
878:       up_irq_restore(flags);
879: 
880:       if (request_probe)
881:         {
882:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
883:         }
884:     }
885: 
886:   return OK;
887: }

902:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));

917:   if (ret < 0)

919:       return ret;
920:     }
921: 
922:   g_initialized = true;
923:   g_physical_started = false;
924:   return OK;

951: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
952:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
953:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
954: {
955:   struct logical_channel *channel;
956:   unsigned int index;
957:   irqstate_t flags;
958:   int ret;
959: 
960:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
961:     {
962:       return -EAGAIN;
963:     }
964: 
965:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
966:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
967:     {
968:       return -EINVAL;
969:     }
970: 
971:   flags = up_irq_save();
972:   channel = &g_channels[index];
973:   if (channel->queued)
974:     {
975:       up_irq_restore(flags);
976:       return -EBUSY;
977:     }
978: 
979:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
980:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
981:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
982:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
983:     {
984:       up_irq_restore(flags);
985:       return -ENOLINK;
986:     }
987: 
988:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
989:     {
990:       up_irq_restore(flags);
991:       return -ENOLINK;
992:     }
993: 
994:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
995:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
996:   channel->callback = callback;
997:   channel->arg = arg;
998:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
999:   channel->queued = true;
1000:   ret = dispatch_locked();
1001:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)
1002:     {
1003:       channel->queued = false;
1004:       channel->result = ret;
1005:     }
1006: 
1007:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1008:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1009:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
1010: }

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | 注册 `ap_console` CLI 命令 |
12: | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | UART0 CP_CLI/AP_CONSOLE owner 状态机、延迟切换和退出转义 |
13: | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | CP UART0 bridge 模式、写入和统计接口 |
14: | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | shell 与 bridge 的切换/链路事件接口 |
15: | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | transport event、诊断和 poll 接口 |
16: | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | MB_UART link event、状态和 poll 接口 |
17: | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | MB_UART0 唯一 owner、LOG/RAW RX、1024 B TX ring 和 worker |
18: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | 完整 ACK 匹配、timeout/reset、probe 和诊断 |
19: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | IPC power-up ready 门禁事件 |
20: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | heartbeat/reset/down 自动回退事件 |
21: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | 严格 DATA/STATE 校验、ACK 后推进和 link event |
22: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | command/ACK/reset/sync 分离稳定 slot |
23: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | 稳定 slot 完成和 quarantine 接口 |
24: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c` | RX 资源门禁、FIFO poll 和 destination count |
25: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.h` | MBOX0 poll、ready callback 和 FIFO count API |
26: | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c` | PWC boot-ready 门禁事件 |
27: | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | BK7258 640 KiB Share SRAM 和 16 MiB PSRAM 布局 |
28: 
29: UART0 bridge 保持 `MB_UART0` 唯一初始化 owner。AP 输出 LOG 模式保留 `ap0:`
30: 前缀、50 ms 半行刷新和有限重试；RAW 模式不改写字节。PC 到 AP 输入使用
31: 1024 B 有界 ring 和部分写 worker，所有物理 UART0 输出仍经 shell queue 串行化。
32: 
33: `ram_regions.csv`采用原厂 `lvgl/img_decode`、`lvgl/freetype_font` 的 16 MiB
34: 七区域布局：

36: ```text

38: 0x60700000..0x60720000  CP PSRAM heap，128 KiB
39: 0x60720000..0x60a00000  AP PSRAM heap，2.875 MiB
40: 0x60a00000..0x61000000  AP PSRAM section，6 MiB
41: ```

100: ## 3. 正确构建链条
101: 
102: 最终固件链条固定为：
103: 
104: ```text
105: OpenVela nuttx.bin
106:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
107:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
108:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
109:   -> package/all-app.bin
110: 
111: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
112:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
113: ```
114: 
115: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
116: 
117: - `ram_regions.csv`
118: - AP/CP `config`
119: - Kconfig 默认值
120: - 分区生成脚本
121: - SoC 链接脚本
122: 
123: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
124: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
125: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
126: 
127: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：
128: 
129: ```bash
130: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
131: ./build.sh \
132:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
133:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
134: 
135: cp \
136:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
137:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
138: ```
139: 
140: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
141: 
142: ```bash
143: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
144: make -C projects/app_ab clean
145: 
146: podman run --rm \
147:   --userns=keep-id \
148:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
149:   -w /armino \
150:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
151:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
152:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
153:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
154: ```
155: 
156: `make -C projects/app_ab clean`只删除`projects/app_ab/build`，不会删除
157: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。
158:

207: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
208: 
209: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
210: 
211: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
212: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
213: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。
214: - 明确排除`0x60700000..0x6071ffff` CP heap的地址检查。
215: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
216: - 当前SMP协议兼容的`0x7/0x8/0x9/0xa`PWC处理和PSRAM_REQUIRED ready门禁。
217: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
218: 
219: 当前CP协议不通过`0xc`或其他命令暴露PSRAM initialized、device ID和actual capacity。
220: `0x7`响应只回显ON/OFF状态，不能单独证明PHY初始化成功或器件为16 MiB。因此当前
221: alias probe是临时运行时门禁，不能替代CP status协议扩展和整颗器件实板测试。

257: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
258: 
259: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
260: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
261: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
262: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
263: 
264: ```text
265: ap_console status
266: ap_console open
267: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
268: <press Ctrl-], release it, then press .>
269: ap_console status
270: ```
271: 
272: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
273: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出时按下`Ctrl-]`、松开，再按`.`；该转义不依赖行首状态。
274: 链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
275: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
276: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。
277: 
278: 当前实现未声称以下项目已在实板验证：深睡 resume、AP/CP 独立重启、FIFO/stale ACK
279: 故障注入和长时间双向压力。这些仍须按移植计划测试矩阵完成。
