47: struct pm_idle_s
48: {
49:   spinlock_t lock;
50:   cpu_set_t running;
51:   cpu_set_t firstdone;
52:   struct smp_call_data_s smp_call_data;
53: };
54: 
55: /****************************************************************************
56:  * Private Function Prototypes
57:  ****************************************************************************/
58: 
59: static int pm_idle_smp_call_cb(FAR void *arg);
60: 
61: /****************************************************************************
62:  * Private Data
63:  ****************************************************************************/
64: 
65: static struct pm_idle_s g_pm_idle =
66: {
67:   SP_UNLOCKED,
68:   PM_SMP_ALL_CPUS,
69:   0,
70:   SMP_CALL_INITIALIZER(pm_idle_smp_call_cb, NULL),
71: };
72: 
73: /****************************************************************************
74:  * Private Functions
75:  ****************************************************************************/
76: 
77: static int pm_idle_smp_call_cb(FAR void *arg)
78: {
79:   return 0;
80: }
81: 
82: /****************************************************************************
83:  * Name: pm_idle_checkstate
84:  *
85:  * Description:
86:  *   Before last CPU enters WFI, verify other CPUs in expected PM state.
87:  *
88:  * Input Parameters:
89:  *   cpu   - the current CPU.
90:  *
91:  * Returned Value:
92:  *   true  - current CPU is still the last CPU.
93:  *   false - current CPU is not the last one.
94:  *
95:  ****************************************************************************/
96: 
97: static bool pm_idle_checkstate(int cpu)
98: {
99:   enum pm_state_e oldstate;
100:   enum pm_state_e newstate;
101:   cpu_set_t cpus;
102:   int i;
103: 
104:   CPU_ZERO(&cpus);
105:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; i++)
106:     {
107:       if (i == cpu)
108:         {
109:           continue;
110:         }
111: 
112:       oldstate = pm_querystate(PM_SMP_CPU_DOMAIN(i));
113:       newstate = pm_checkstate(PM_SMP_CPU_DOMAIN(i));
114:       if (oldstate != newstate)
115:         {
116:           CPU_SET(i, &cpus);
117:         }
118:     }
119: 
120:   if (CPU_COUNT(&cpus) > 0)
121:     {
122:       nxsched_smp_call_async(cpus, &g_pm_idle.smp_call_data);
123:       return false;
124:     }
125: 
126:   return true;
127: }
128: 
129: /****************************************************************************
130:  * Public Functions
131:  ****************************************************************************/
132: 
133: /****************************************************************************
134:  * Name: pm_idle_unlock
135:  *
136:  * Description:
137:  *   Release SMP idle cpus lock, allow other cpu continue idle process.
138:  *
139:  * Input Parameters:
140:  *   None.
141:  *
142:  * Returned Value:
143:  *   None.
144:  *
145:  ****************************************************************************/
146: 
147: void pm_idle_unlock(void)
148: {
149:   spin_unlock(&g_pm_idle.lock);
150: }
151: 
152: /****************************************************************************
153:  * Name: pm_idle_lock
154:  *
155:  * Description:
156:  *   Claim SMP idle cpus lock, other cpu have to wait until released.
157:  *
158:  * Input Parameters:
159:  *   cpu - The current CPU, used to update cpu_set_t
160:  *
161:  * Returned Value:
162:  *   true  - Current CPU is the first one woken from sleep, should handle
163:  *           system domain restore process also.
164:  *   false - Current CPU is not the first one woken from sleep, should only
165:  *           handle cpu domain restore process.
166:  *
167:  * Assumptions:
168:  *   Restore operation pm_changestate(, PM_RESTORE) will done inside pm_idle.
169:  *   Handler don't have to care about it.
170:  *
171:  ****************************************************************************/
172: 
173: bool pm_idle_lock(int cpu)
174: {
175:   bool first;
176:   spin_lock(&g_pm_idle.lock);
177:   first = (g_pm_idle.running == 0);
178:   CPU_SET(cpu, &g_pm_idle.running);
179:   return first;
180: }
